MicheliR: An R Toolkit for the Micheli Guide to Fungal Conservation Policy Gap Assessment

Source: R/server.R
MicheliR-package.Rd

A Shiny-based toolkit for deterministic keyword searches (Fungi, Animals, Plants) with full audit logs, and optional AI-assisted (DeepSeek) evaluation using the Micheli Guide framework. It automates the assessment of CBD National Reports and NBSAPs to identify gaps in fungal conservation policy.
